title.zh: CFTC and SEC Double Down on Crypto After Clarity Act Defeat
title.en: CFTC and SEC Double Down on Crypto After Clarity Act Defeat

current_state.zh: After the Senate failed to advance the Clarity Act, CFTC Chair Michael Selig and SEC Chair Paul Atkins pledged to pursue crypto regulatory clarity using their agencies' existing powers.
